summary: Russian forces launched a massive wave of reactive UAVs (Shahed/Geran-5) targeting Kyiv and at least eight Ukrainian oblasts, causing damage in three Kyiv districts and one death in Bucha district. Ukrainian Neptune missiles struck the railway portion of the Kerch Bridge, halting train traffic. Ukrainian drones attacked the Kaleykino oil pumping station in Tatarstan, 1,200–1,300 km from the border, triggering a large fire. (Sources: @UkraineNow/85398, @UkraineNow/85396, @eRadarrua/131762)
key_points: Russian reactive UAVs attacked Kyiv from multiple directions, damaging residential buildings, an office, a medical facility, and nine vehicles in Holosiivskyi, Desnianskyi, and Podilskyi districts, with one killed and one injured in Bucha district. (Source: @UkraineNow/85398)
Ukrainian Neptune missiles hit the railway portion of the Kerch Bridge, striking the arch and tracks, stopping train movement. (Source: @UkraineNow/85396)

Ukrainian drones struck the Kaleykino main oil pumping station in Tatarstan's Almetyevsk district, approximately 1,200–1,300 km from the Ukrainian border, causing at least 16 explosions and a massive fire. (Source: @eRadarrua/131762)

Russian forces launched reactive UAV groups across at least eight Ukrainian regions: Kyiv (4 groups), Chernihiv (2-3 groups), Dnipropetrovsk (2 groups), Donetsk (1 group), Zaporizhzhia (1 group), Poltava (3 groups), Kirovohrad (1 group), Kherson (1 group). (Source: @eRadarrua/131787, @eRadarrua/131797, @eRadarrua/131822, @eRadarrua/131830, @eRadarrua/131837)
Russian Geran-5 rockets were reported over Kyiv's Livoberezhnyi masiv, Obolon, and center, and past Kyiv towards Brovary. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78445, @mon1tor_ua/78429, @mon1tor_ua/78444)
Russian attacks hit Naftogaz facilities in Dnipropetrovsk and Poltava regions. (Source: @UkraineNow/85382)
A prisoner exchange of 1,000+ personnel is planned, prioritizing seriously ill, women, and those held longest. (Source: @UkraineNow/85381)
Ukrainian drone procurement system DOT-Chain Defence has delivered 1.5 million drones to the military from 300 producers with average 9-day delivery. (Source: @UkraineNow/85395)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces conducted a large-scale drone offensive against Kyiv and multiple Ukrainian regions, employing reactive UAVs and Geran-5 rockets that caused infrastructure damage and casualties in the capital. Ukrainian forces responded with precision strikes: Neptune missiles disabled the Kerch Bridge railway link, while long-range drones hit a strategic Russian oil pumping station in Tatarstan, over 1,200 km from the front. Simultaneously, a major prisoner exchange of over 1,000 personnel was announced, and Ukraine's defense procurement system reported delivery of 1.5 million drones in its first year. (Sources: @UkraineNow/85398, @UkraineNow/85396, @eRadarrua/131762, @UkraineNow/85381, @UkraineNow/85395)

points: Ukrainian Neptune anti-ship missiles successfully struck the railway section of the Kerch Bridge, hitting the arch and tracks, which halted all train traffic across the bridge — a critical logistics artery for Russian forces in southern Ukraine. (Source: @UkraineNow/85396)

Ukrainian long-range drones attacked the Kaleykino main oil pumping station in Tatarstan's Almetyevsk district, a key node of the Transneft pipeline system, causing at least 16 explosions and a massive fire; the facility lies 1,200–1,300 km from the Ukrainian border. (Source: @eRadarrua/131762)

Ukraine's defense procurement agency DOT-Chain Defence delivered 1.5 million drones to the military in its first year, sourcing from 300 domestic producers with an average delivery time of 9 days, including FPV fiber-optic drones, bombers, interceptors, and electronic warfare systems. (Source: @UkraineNow/85395)
A new prisoner exchange of 1,000+ personnel is being prepared, with priority given to seriously ill prisoners, women, and those held longest in Russian captivity. (Source: @UkraineNow/85381)

Ukrainian drone strikes in November damaged or halted operations at 15 of 35 large Russian oil refineries, reducing Russian oil refining capacity by approximately 45% according to Reuters. (Source: @UkraineNow/85384)
Ukrainian forces conducted a repeat attack on the Kerch Bridge, with monitoring channels reporting the bridge under renewed assault. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78431)

Russian forces launched a massive coordinated drone attack on Kyiv and surrounding regions, deploying reactive UAVs (Shahed/Geran-5) from multiple axes including Chernihiv, Poltava, and Dnipropetrovsk directions, with at least 4 groups targeting Kyiv region, 2-3 groups Chernihiv region, 3 groups Poltava region, and 2 groups Dnipropetrovsk region. (Source: @eRadarrua/131787, @eRadarrua/131797, @eRadarrua/131822, @eRadarrua/131830)

The attack on Kyiv caused damage in Holosiivskyi, Desnianskyi, and Podilskyi districts: a residential building, an office, a medical facility, and nine vehicles were damaged; one person was killed and one injured in Bucha district. (Source: @UkraineNow/85398)

Russian Geran-5 rockets were observed over Kyiv's Livoberezhnyi masiv near Darnytsia and Chernihivska metro, over Obolon towards Podil, and past Kyiv towards Brovary. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78445, @mon1tor_ua/78444, @mon1tor_ua/78429)
Russian strikes targeted Naftogaz energy infrastructure in Dnipropetrovsk and Poltava regions; consequences are being assessed. (Source: @UkraineNow/85382)
A reactive Shahed drone targeted the Kremenchuk oil refinery (NPZ) in Poltava region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78430)

Putin threatened a 'much more painful' response to Ukrainian attacks on the Kerch Bridge, claiming the bridge is an exclusively peaceful object and ruling out partial ceasefires on strikes. (Source: @UkraineNow/85405)
Putin asserted that the 'Kyiv regime' started the war in southeastern Ukraine and does not want to stop hostilities. (Source: @UkraineNow/85404)
Russian forces advanced near Rai-Oleksandrivka in Donetsk region, according to the latest DeepState map update. (Source: @DeepStateUA/24013)
Russian reactive UAV groups were active in Donetsk region (1 group) and Zaporizhzhia region (1 group) during the reporting period. (Source: @eRadarrua/131787)
No specific ground combat details or unit movements beyond the Rai-Oleksandrivka advance were reported in the source messages for the eastern front.

Russian reactive UAVs launched from Chernihiv region (near Honcharivske, Olyshivka, Berezna) flew westward and southward toward Kyiv region, with multiple groups tracked crossing into Kyiv oblast. (Source: @kpszsu/97402, @kpszsu/97431, @kpszsu/97400)
Additional reactive UAVs originated from Bryansk region (Russia) heading toward Chernihiv region, indicating cross-border launch points. (Source: @eRadarrua/131768)
Reactive UAVs were observed over northern Kyiv region past Borodianka moving south, and near Hostomel from the northwest. (Source: @kpszsu/97410, @kpszsu/97423)
Several reactive UAVs north of Kyiv region were tracked heading toward Zhytomyr region via Krasiatychi. (Source: @kpszsu/97408)
Air defense monitoring reported reactive UAV groups in Chernihiv region (2-3 groups) and Kyiv region (4 groups) simultaneously. (Source: @eRadarrua/131784, @eRadarrua/131797)

Ukrainian Neptune missiles struck the railway portion of the Kerch Bridge, damaging the arch and tracks, halting train traffic — a critical supply line for Russian forces in southern Ukraine. (Source: @UkraineNow/85396)
Monitoring channels reported the Kerch Bridge under repeated attack. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78431)
A reactive UAV group was active in Kherson region (1 group) and a reactive UAV was circling over Zaporizhzhia city. (Source: @eRadarrua/131837, @mon1tor_ua/78428)
Russian reactive UAVs launched from temporarily occupied Zaporizhzhia region targeted temporarily occupied Kherson region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78428)
No naval or amphibious operations were reported in the source messages for the southern front.

Russian forces employed large numbers of reactive UAVs (Shahed/Geran-5) across at least eight Ukrainian regions simultaneously: Kyiv (4 groups), Chernihiv (2-3 groups), Dnipropetrovsk (2 groups), Donetsk (1 group), Zaporizhzhia (1 group), Poltava (3 groups), Kirovohrad (1 group), Kherson (1 group). (Source: @eRadarrua/131787, @eRadarrua/131797, @eRadarrua/131822, @eRadarrua/131830, @eRadarrua/131837)

Geran-5 rockets were used in addition to Shahed drones, with specific sightings over Kyiv's Livoberezhnyi masiv, Obolon, city center, and towards Brovary. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78445, @mon1tor_ua/78444, @mon1tor_ua/78429)
UAVs over Kyiv flew at critically low altitudes, complicating air defense engagement. (Source: @eRadarrua/131808)
Multiple air raid alerts were declared in Kyiv: at 13:46, 14:33, with all-clear at 13:27 and 14:00 on 19.11.2026. (Source: @eRadarrua/131765, @eRadarrua/131785, @eRadarrua/131760, @eRadarrua/131777)
Russian launches from Orel (Russia) included 3 groups of reactive UAVs. (Source: @eRadarrua/131792)

Ukrainian air defense engaged targets over Kyiv districts including Darnytsia, Lukianivka, Syrets, Poznyaky, Bereznyaky, Obolon, Podil, and central areas. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78451, @mon1tor_ua/78454, @mon1tor_ua/78453, @mon1tor_ua/78436, @mon1tor_ua/78448, @kpszsu/97414)
Reactive UAVs were also reported over Dnipropetrovsk region targeting Aviatorske/Dnipro, Synelnykove, Mahdalynivka, and Samar areas. (Source: @kpszsu/97409, @kpszsu/97401, @kpszsu/97392)

Ukrainian drones struck Tatarstan's Kaleykino oil pumping station 1,200+ km inside Russia, causing major fire. (Source: @eRadarrua/131762)

sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous mass drone offensive across eight Ukrainian regions demonstrates Russia's capacity to sustain high-intensity aerial attrition while Ukraine's long-range strike capability reaches deep into Russian strategic infrastructure, as evidenced by the Tatarstan attack 1,300 km from the border. The Kerch Bridge railway disablement degrades Russian southern logistics, likely forcing greater reliance on the vulnerable land corridor. Putin's explicit threat of escalated retaliation and rejection of strike ceasefires signals intent to intensify attacks on Ukrainian energy and urban centers. Ukraine's drone procurement scale (1.5M units) and domestic production base suggest growing asymmetric advantage in UAV warfare. The planned 1,000+ prisoner exchange indicates ongoing backchannel negotiations despite public hostility.
sections.regional_response: NATO allies are studying Ukraine's DOT-Chain Defence procurement model for rapid drone acquisition, while the EU and Slovenia restrict Russian visas and plan entry bans for war-involved individuals. Rome cancelled a Russian film festival under European Parliament pressure. The Trump-Xi-Putin joint declaration omitted Ukraine, reflecting great-power focus on UN reform and energy markets rather than conflict resolution.
